_comment: House tier (the `model:` of agents/*.md: main | complex | executor) → the model each harness gives that agent. Read by `jig apply --target claude`, `--target codex` and `--target omp` (jig/src/domain/claude/agent-models.ts). Ruled by rules/decisions/2026-10-19-model-assignment.md: complex is the stronger model, main the everyday one, executor the cheapest (the local model where the harness reaches LiteLLM). Effort comes from each agent's own `effort:`.
claude — Anthropic's aliases (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config): complex → opus, main → sonnet, executor → haiku.
codex — current ids (https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/models): complex → gpt-6-sol, main and executor → gpt-6-luna, OpenAI's 'most efficient model for focused, high-volume tasks'. astra is not mapped.
omp — every model goes through the local LiteLLM proxy by tier name (provider `proxy`).
